purpose: RadReirradiation is a 3D Slicer scripted module for radiotherapy re-irradiation analysis, voxel-based EQD2/BED biological dose calculation, sequential boost integration, and DVH metrics generation.
summary: RadReirradiation is a robustly documented 3D Slicer extension for radiotherapy re-irradiation analysis and biological dose summation. It meets all packaging, licensing, and safety requirements. 🟢 Recommend merge

safety.rationale: No malicious code, network telemetry, or unsafe execution patterns found. Runtime installation of pydicom occurs only upon user request (DICOM export).

environment.rationale: No global environment side effects or unauthorized package pins/downloads at import time.

packaging.rationale: CMakeLists.txt correctly configures the scripted module and dependencies (SlicerRT).

license.rationale: Standard MIT license present in repository.

soundness.rationale: Structured properly as a ScriptedLoadableModule with standard Slicer conventions and UI controls.

utility.rationale: Extensive documentation, tutorials, and disclaimers provided in README.md.

findings.title: Runtime installation of pydicom
findings.explanation: The module installs `pydicom` on demand via `slicer.util.pip_install("pydicom")` when exporting DICOM. While pydicom is generally safe and common in medical imaging, installing packages at runtime rather than declaring them in extension dependencies can cause environment side-effects or fail if offline. However, there is no malicious intent.

findings.title: Dependencies and packaging correctly declared
findings.explanation: CMake lists SlicerRT as the extension dependency, which matches the README requirements. All necessary scripts are bundled and registered via slicerMacroBuildScriptedModule.

findings.title: Valid MIT License present
findings.explanation: The repository includes a standard MIT License file with proper copyright attribution, permitting distribution.

findings.title: Comprehensive documentation and disclaimers
findings.evidence: 8  set(EXTENSION_DESCRIPTION "A clinical tool for Reirradiation analysis, EQD2 dose calculation, and integrated DVH metrics.")
findings.explanation: The extension is well-documented with a comprehensive README, tutorials, clinical workflow steps, and standard research/educational use disclaimers.

not_checked: Full mathematical verification of voxel-based radiobiology EQD2/BED calculations and DVH metric accuracy against clinical gold standards.
